name: Worldly Things
overview: Scripture warns believers against conforming to worldly values, emphasizing that gaining the world at the cost of one's soul is a tragic loss (Matthew 16:26; Romans 12:2). Instead, believers are called to rely on the Lord's strength and guidance, trusting that He fights for them and renews their strength as they wait upon Him (Exodus 14:14; Isaiah 40:31; Isaiah 41:10). Furthermore, Christians are instructed to reject the unfruitful works of darkness and actively reprove them, living transformed lives that reflect God's perfect will (Ephesians 5:11; Romans 12:2).
